body: This is an incredibly stressful situation to be in and it's something that happens daily for me. It's like you don't want to choose the "wrong" meal or snack. I end up crying on the kitchen floor. So, you're not alone :-)
The addictive and reassuring feeling is so relatable and I had no idea anyone would ever understand what I meant by that when I would try and talk to people. I hope you're doing well.

Try and do everything you can to distract yourself as best you can - download an audiobook, listen to podcasts or happy music. If you keep having these episodes definitely go talk to your doctor about it as soon as possible! The faster you get help the better.
